name: Aarav Sharma
feedback_comment: Bahut achha product hai! Escrow system bilkul transparent laga. Stellar ki speed bhi amazing hai.

name: Sneha Gupta

name: Deepika Agarwal
feedback_comment: Security features bahut strong hain. Smart contract audit ka link bhi dena chahiye documentation me.

name: Kunal Bhatia

name: Siddharth Kaur
feedback_comment: Arbitration layer is a great addition. Real-world use case me yeh bahut helpful hoga.

name: Riya Tiwari
feedback_comment: Overall experience was 9/10. Just need a mobile app and it will be perfect for Indian market.

name: Aditya Kulkarni
feedback_comment: Testnet mein sab smooth chala. Mainnet deployment ke baad definitely use karunga apne clients ke liye.
